'''Isabela's 5th congressional district''' is one of the six [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Isabela (province)|Isabela]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 2019.<ref name="congleg">{{cite web|title=Roster of Philippine legislators|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province|publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]|accessdate=April 30, 2020|archive-date=March 16, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province|url-status=dead}}</ref> The district consists of the municipalities of [[Aurora, Isabela|Aurora]], [[Burgos, Isabela|Burgos]], [[Luna, Isabela|Luna]], [[Mallig, Isabela|Mallig]], [[Quezon, Isabela|Quezon]], [[Quirino, Isabela|Quirino]], [[Roxas, Isabela|Roxas]], and [[San Manuel, Isabela|San Manuel]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Mike Dy III|Faustino Michael Carlos T. Dy III]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]], who has represented the district since its creation.<ref name="congmem">{{cite web|title=House Members|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/|publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]|accessdate=April 30, 2020}}</ref>
